description: Read-only planning/forecast query for campaign, ad group, or portfolio bidding simulations. Returns simulation metadata and projected point lists when available, with a metadata fallback.

adGroupId.description: Optional ad group ID filter for ad_group simulations

biddingStrategyId.description: Optional portfolio bidding strategy ID filter for bidding_strategy simulations

campaignId.description: Optional campaign ID filter. Applies directly to campaign simulations and as campaign context for ad group simulations.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID (without dashes, e.g., 1234567890)

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

modificationMethod.description: Optional SimulationModificationMethod enum, e.g. UNIFORM, SCALING, DEFAULT

simulationEndDate.description: Optional maximum simulation end date YYYY-MM-DD

simulationStartDate.description: Optional minimum simulation start date YYYY-MM-DD

typeFilter.description: Optional SimulationType enum, e.g. BUDGET, TARGET_CPA, TARGET_ROAS, CPC_BID

name: google_ads_get_simulations

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: google ads get simulations
